info.name: Gazebo - Food API
info.description:
# Gazebo Food API

## Base URL
`locations_base_url` = `http://localhost:8000`

## Auth
1. Run **Users & Access Control → Auth → Login** (`POST /auth/login/`)
2. Tokens are saved to environment (`access_token`)
3. Container CRUD uses Bearer `{{access_token}}`

## Containers CRUD
Under `/container/{resource}/`:
- `GET` list (nested `children[]` tree)
- `POST` create
- `GET /:id/` detail
- `PATCH /:id/` update
- `DELETE /:id/` delete

Resources: locations, suppliers, customers, couriers, departments, storage

item.name: Locations (containers)

request.description:
### Purpose
List locations that have the **supplier** role.

### Request body
**None**.

### Query parameters
Same optional filters as **List locations**: `q`, `role`, `zone_parent_id`, `subordinate_parent_id`.

### Response body (HTTP 200)
`data.count` and `data.results[]` of summary objects. Message: `Supplier list fetched successfully.`

### Purpose
Get one supplier by ID (must have supplier role).

### Request body
**None**.

### Response
Full location object in `data` (HTTP 200). **404** if ID missing or not a supplier (`Supplier not found.`).

### Purpose
List locations with the **customer** role.

### Request body
**None**.

### Query parameters
Optional: `q`, `role`, `zone_parent_id`, `subordinate_parent_id` (same as list locations).

### Response (200)
```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "Customer list fetched successfully.",
  "data": { "count": 0, "results": [] }
}
```
`results[]` items use the **summary** shape (id, name, roles, features, flags).

### Purpose
Get one customer by ID.

### Request body
**None**.

### Response (200)
Full location in `data`. Message: `Customer fetched successfully.`

### Response (404)
`{ "status": "error", "message": "Customer not found.", "data": null }`

### List locations (nested tree)

`GET /container/locations/`

Requires Bearer token. `data.results` is a nested forest with `children[]`.

### Get location by ID

`GET /container/locations/:id/`

Requires Bearer token.

### Purpose
List **departments** — locations with role internal, process, or transform.

### Request body
**None**.

### Query parameters
| Param | Values | What it does |
|-------|--------|----------------|
| department_only | `true`, `1`, `yes` | If set, only locations with **process** role (narrower list) |
| q | text | Name search |
| zone_parent_id | ID | Filter by zone parent |
| subordinate_parent_id | ID | Filter by subordinate parent |
| role | code | Extra role filter |

### Response (200)
`data.count` + `data.results[]` summaries. Message: `Department list fetched successfully.`

### Create department

`POST /container/departments/create/` (alias of `POST /container/departments/`)

Body: `name`, `description`, `location` (parent name or id).
Requires Bearer token.

### Purpose
Get one department by ID (must match department role rules).

### Request body
**None**.

### Response (200)
Full location in `data`. Message: `Department fetched successfully.`

### Response (404)
`Department not found.`

### Purpose
List **storage** locations (role = storage).

### Request body
**None**.

### Query parameters
| Param | Notes |
|-------|--------|
| storage_class | Optional. Filters **after** fetch: keeps rows whose **name** contains this text (case-insensitive). Example: `chilled` |
| q, role, zone_parent_id, subordinate_parent_id | Same as other list endpoints |

### Response (200)
`data.count` + `data.results[]`. Message: `Storage location list fetched successfully.`

### Purpose
Get one storage location by ID.

### Request body
**None**.

### Response (200)
Full location in `data`. Message: `Storage location fetched successfully.`

### Response (404)
`Storage location not found.`

item.name: Recipes

request.description:
POST `/recipe/`

**Required:** `product_id` (one recipe per product).
**Optional:** `name`, `remarks`.

409 if recipe already exists for product.

POST `/recipe/:id/versions/`

Creates a version. Status defaults to `draft`. Do not set `status: active` — use Activate.

**Optional:** `version_number` (auto-increments), `status` (`draft`|`approved`|`retired`), `process_loss`, `batch_quantity`, `batch_unit_id`, `sum_*`, `location_id`, `effective_from`, `effective_to`, `remarks`.

PATCH `/recipe/versions/:id/`

Partial update. Cannot set `status: active` here — use Activate.
`process_loss` must be > 0.

POST `/recipe/versions/:id/activate/`

Makes this version `active` (previous active for same recipe is retired).

PATCH `/recipe/components/:id/`

Partial update of a component line.

DELETE `/recipe/components/:id/`

Deletes component and syncs product `has_recipe`.

item.description:
# Recipes

Base: `/recipe/`

| Method | Path | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| GET/POST | `/recipe/` | list / create |
| GET | `/recipe/:id/` | detail + versions |
| POST | `/recipe/:id/versions/` | create version (not `active`) |
| GET/PATCH | `/recipe/versions/:id/` | detail / update |
| POST | `/recipe/versions/:id/activate/` | set active |
| POST | `/recipe/versions/:id/components/` | add line |
| PATCH/DELETE | `/recipe/components/:id/` | update / delete line |

Vars: `recipe_id`, `recipe_version_id`, `recipe_component_id`, `product_id`
